ends.note: dead end at the John Shillito Co. store wall; does not reach Race Street

notes: Garfield Place (126 ft, central esplanade) is offset from West 8th Street: W 8th, entering Elm from the west (block lines y 841/1028, unlabelled on this sheet, name from key map), has its centreline at y 935, about the line of Garfield Place's north roadway; Garfield Place's own centreline (block lines y 926/1366) is at y 1147. Recorded as two T-junctions on Elm. Shillito Place continues west of Elm as George Street (printed on the sheet). L'Hommedieu Alley dead-ends at the Shillito store wall at x 2392 and does not reach Race; the alley meeting Race from the east at y 2648 is L'Hommedieu Alley's continuation on sheet 46 (named there), so it is a separate T. Borden Alley label is partly covered by a symbol here; the name is confirmed on sheet 46. The 'alleys' entry is an unnamed ~10 ft alley on the west side of Elm (sheet 44) whose east end at Elm is all that shows; it continues west off the drawn area. West of Elm, 6th Street widens to the north (market space; NW block line at y 3506); the Elm/6th point uses the 6th Street lines east of Elm (y 3700/3928).
